lines.text: On a noisy platform @sai_front slips on @headphones_black, and the crowd noise drops away to music.
Sound cuts to the music on the put-on.

new_beats.text: Some days, you just need to hear yourself think.

writes.note: I added one VO line over the put-on and kept your action and direction as they were.

reply.rationale: The shot already has the action and the sound cut, so a short VO line over the put-on adds the narrator without repeating them. It runs about 2 s, well inside the 15 s target.
